licence_note: EU legislation may be reused under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU. The wording of this summary is the software's own.
title: General Data Protection Regulation
issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
description: The papers in a dispute hold personal data, often special-category or criminal-offence data. The deployer is the controller. National law in each member state completes the Regulation.

requirements.title: Purpose limitation and data minimisation
requirements.text: Personal data in the papers is used only for this matter; logs hold identifiers and hashes, not content; nothing is carried between matters.

requirements.title: Only the personal data the task needs
requirements.text: Personal details are mentioned only where the task needs them.
requirements.instruction: Mention a person's personal details only where the task needs them, and refer to people by the name or role the documents give them.

requirements.title: Accuracy
requirements.text: Personal data is reproduced exactly as the documents give it.
requirements.instruction: Quote personal data exactly as it appears in the documents. Never infer, complete or correct a person's details.

requirements.title: Special categories of personal data
requirements.text: Special-category data is neither inferred nor speculated about.
requirements.instruction: Never infer or speculate about anyone's health, ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade-union membership, genetic or biometric data, sex life or sexual orientation. Mention such matters only as the documents state them and only where the task needs it.

requirements.title: A lawful basis
requirements.text: There is a lawful basis for the processing, and a condition for any special-category or criminal-offence data.
requirements.statement: There is a lawful basis for processing the personal data in this matter, including any special-category or criminal-offence data.

requirements.title: No decision based solely on automated processing
requirements.text: No decision with legal or similarly significant effect on a person is based solely on this output; a named person reviews it and decides.

requirements.title: Data protection by design and by default
requirements.text: Network denied by default; models run on the same machine; records isolated by matter; logs minimised.

requirements.title: Security of processing
requirements.text: Access by role and matter, proven identity, tamper-evident records and a hardened server. Encryption at rest and backups are the deployer's.

requirements.title: Data-protection impact assessment
requirements.text: The controller assesses the impact of the processing before it starts, where it is likely to result in a high risk.

requirements.title: Personal-data breaches
requirements.text: A breach is notified to the supervisory authority within 72 hours unless it is unlikely to result in a risk, and to the people affected where the risk is high.
